# Knowledge Base: shannon-entropy-oq-03-incomplete-01

## Problem Understanding

The target is strong subadditivity of Shannon entropy:

$$
H(X,Y,Z) + H(Y) \leq H(X,Y) + H(Y,Z)
$$

The local problem note says the supporting infrastructure is already in `ShannonEntropySSA.lean`; the remaining work is the main theorem left as a `sorry`.

## Known Direction

Use the parent proof `shannon-entropy-oq-03` as the foundation. The stated goal is to express the deficit as conditional mutual information, `I(X;Z|Y) = sum_y p(y) D(p(x,z|y) || p(x|y) * p(z|y))`, then use KL divergence non-negativity.

## Current State

No attempts have been recorded yet. The next action in `state.md` is to read the problem thoroughly and then move to ORIENT by exploring literature and related proofs.
